facts.text: Lunar Roving Vehicle (LRV-3) was deployed at Taurus-Littrow during Apollo 17 in 1972.
The third and final lunar rover. Cernan set the unofficial lunar speed record of 17.1 km/h on this vehicle. Parked at its final TV position to film the last human departure from the Moon.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Enabled exploration across 35.9 km of the Taurus-Littrow valley, reaching geological stations at the North and South Massifs and Shorty Crater where the orange soil was discovered.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Taurus-Littrow.
Holds the unofficial lunar speed record of 17.1 km/h set by Cernan; parked at its final TV position to film humanity's last departure from the Moon.
